An Amalfi Coast escape… without ever leaving Chicago. 🍋✨

Some weddings are beautiful.

The unforgettable ones are the weddings where every single detail becomes part of the guest experience.

From the moment guests were greeted with a champagne skirt hostess 🥂 to sipping Aperol Spritzes, tequila cocktails, and Veuve Clicquot beneath the city skyline, every element was designed to transport them straight to the Italian coast.

Some of our favorite moments:
✨ A champagne skirt from @newmoonchicago that welcomed guests in style
📸 A photo booth where every guest left a printed photo and handwritten note for the couple
🍰 Mini cakes by @flourishcakedesign  paired with incredible desserts from @mindysbakery 
🍋 Aperol Spritz, Champagne, and Tequila carts that kept the celebration flowing
🎨 A live fashion sketch artist creating original keepsakes throughout the evening

We believe the most memorable weddings don’t just look beautiful, they create moments guests will talk about long after the last dance.

Which detail would YOU be most excited to experience as a guest? Tell us below! 👇

Wrapping up an album for this amazing couple this week and looking through the photos brought me right back to this incredible evening. This was another couple who was emphatic about simply enjoying the night and the party and allowing us to just document what transpired. I loved the flow of this reception, with cocktails throughout the library and patio; dinner in a faux bois walled tent and regal great hall that echoed a feeling of Britain, where the brides mother (an incredible floral designer) lives; dancing in a lounge; and an after party under a disco ball in a tent. An absolute banger of a night 🪩

Happy Valentine’s Day ❤️✨

Today we’re celebrating love in its most beautiful form—and looking back at Claire and Dominic’s unforgettable October 19th celebration at Cafe Brauer.

After spending this week showing you what goes on behind the scenes of our coordination work, this is the why. This is what all those hours of timeline planning, vendor coordination, and problem-solving deliver: couples who are fully present, completely stress-free, and able to soak in every moment of their celebration.

Claire and Dominic trusted us with the details so they could focus on each other, their community, and the joy of the day. That’s what professional coordination gives you—the freedom to be exactly where you want to be: in the moment.

This Valentine’s Day, we’re grateful for every couple who’s trusted us to bring their vision to life. And we’re excited for the celebrations still to come in 2026.

💕 Speaking of 2026... we have 4 remaining dates for weddings. If you want this level of care, attention, and expertise for your celebration, now is the time to secure your date.

DM “VALENTINE” to start the conversation, or visit our website to schedule a consultation. Let’s create something unforgettable together.
